entries.subject: DAMIT 6218: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-6218.txt. Model 6218, version 2022-10-18, pole (10°, 39°), period 14.60796 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 28.4 ±0.9 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: This view uses [model 6218](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/6218) at its published scale and paired pole. [Model 6219](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/6219) is an alternative pole/shape solution, excluded from this presentation without claiming the selected pole is unique. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 6219: pole (174°, 36°), 14.60796 h, version 2022-10-18, archive diameter 28.3 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale in the astronomy record's mean radius 14.2 km (diameter 28.4 km) is outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 535 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 25.956 ± 0.572 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). The display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
